mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right type of doors for an indoor-outdoor transition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right doors depends on your aesthetic preference, functional needs, and budget. Popular options include bifold doors, which fold completely open to create a wide opening, and multi-slide doors, which stack or pocket into a wall. French doors offer a classic look for smaller openings. Consider material (wood, aluminum, vinyl), energy efficiency, security, and how much clear opening you desire. We can help you evaluate options during the design phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider bifold, multi-slide, or French doors based on aesthetics, function, budget, material, and desired opening size.
